/* BillSaleBensonMapper.getBillSaleBensonList */
SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(tssd2.SALE_DATE, 'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS SALE_DATE, tssd2.BILL_NO, tssd2.STORE_CD, tssd2.STORE_NM, tmp.PROD_NM, SUM(tssd2.SALE_QTY) AS SALE_QTY1, SUM(tssd2.TOT_SALE_AMT) AS TOT_SALE_AMT1, SUM(tssd2.REAL_SALE_AMT) AS REAL_SALE_AMT1
FROM ( SELECT A.SALE_DATE , A.BILL_NO , A.STORE_CD , A.STORE_NM , DECODE(A.SEL_TYPE_FG, 'S', A.SIDE_P_PROD_CD, A.PROD_CD) AS PROD_CD , DECODE(A.SEL_TYPE_FG, 'S', 0, A.SALE_QTY) AS SALE_QTY , A.TOT_SALE_AMT , A.REAL_SALE_AMT , A.SEL_TYPE_FG , DECODE(A.SEL_TYPE_FG, 'S', 'P' , A.SEL_TYPE_FG) AS SEL_TYPE_FG FROM ( SELECT tssd.SALE_DATE, tssd.BILL_NO, tssd.STORE_CD, tms.STORE_NM, tssd.PROD_CD, SUM(tssd.SALE_QTY) AS SALE_QTY, SUM(tssd.SALE_AMT) AS TOT_SALE_AMT, SUM(tssd.REAL_SALE_AMT) AS REAL_SALE_AMT, (CASE WHEN ( tssd.SIDE_P_DTL_NO = tssd.BILL_DTL_NO OR tssd.SIDE_P_PROD_CD = tssd.PROD_CD OR ( tssd.SIDE_P_DTL_NO IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(tssd.SIDE_P_PROD_CD) IS NULL ) ) THEN ( CASE WHEN tssd.SINGLE_PROD_CD IS NOT NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'P' END ) WHEN ( tssd.SIDE_P_DTL_NO != tssd.BILL_DTL_NO AND TRIM(tssd.SIDE_P_PROD_CD) IS NOT NULL ) THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END) AS SEL_TYPE_FG , tssd.SIDE_P_PROD_CD FROM TB_SL_SALE_DTL tssd, TB_MS_STORE tms, TB_MS_STORE_INFO tmsi WHERE 1=1 AND tssd.HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} AND tssd.SALE_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND tssd.STORE_CD IN (${storeCdQuery})
AND tms.HQ_BRAND_CD = #{storeHqBrandCd} -- 매장브랜드 선택일때
-- 매장브랜드 전체일때 AND tms.HQ_BRAND_CD IN
#{item}
AND tms.STORE_CD = tssd.STORE_CD AND tmsi.STORE_CD (+)= tms.STORE_CD GROUP BY tssd.SALE_DATE, tssd.BILL_NO, tssd.STORE_CD, tms.STORE_NM, tssd.PROD_CD, tssd.SIDE_P_DTL_NO, tssd.BILL_DTL_NO, tssd.SIDE_P_PROD_CD, tssd.SINGLE_PROD_CD ) A ) tssd2 , TB_MS_PRODUCT tmp WHERE 1=1 AND tmp.STORE_CD = 'S615806' -- 속도를 위해 상품 매장코드 고정(벤슨 기준매장) AND tmp.PROD_CD = tssd2.PROD_CD
AND tmp.PROD_CLASS_CD IN ( SELECT PROD_CLASS_CD FROM TB_MS_PRODUCT_CLASS WHERE STORE_CD = tmp.STORE_CD START WITH PROD_CLASS_CD = #{prodClassCd} AND STORE_CD = tmp.STORE_CD CONNECT BY PRIOR PROD_CLASS_CD = P_PROD_CLASS_CD AND STORE_CD = tmp.STORE_CD )
AND tssd2.PROD_CD LIKE '%'||#{prodCd}||'%'
AND tssd2.PROD_CD IN (${prodCdQuery})
AND tmp.PROD_NM LIKE '%'||#{prodNm}||'%'
AND tmp.HQ_BRAND_CD = #{prodHqBrandCd} -- 상품브랜드 선택일때
-- 상품브랜드 전체일때 AND tmp.HQ_BRAND_CD IN
#{item}
GROUP BY tssd2.SALE_DATE, tssd2.BILL_NO, tssd2.STORE_CD, tssd2.STORE_NM, tssd2.PROD_CD, tmp.PROD_NM ORDER BY tssd2.SALE_DATE, tssd2.BILL_NO, tssd2.STORE_CD, tssd2.PROD_CD

#{item}

AND tssd2.PROD_CD IN (${prodCdQuery})

-- 상품브랜드 전체일때 AND tmp.HQ_BRAND_CD IN
#{item}
GROUP BY tssd2.SALE_DATE, tssd2.BILL_NO, tssd2.STORE_CD, tssd2.STORE_NM, tssd2.PROD_CD, tmp.PROD_NM ORDER BY tssd2.SALE_DATE, tssd2.BILL_NO, tssd2.STORE_CD, tssd2.PROD_CD
